audit_items.proof_trace: Validator self-publish path calls blockchain.ReceiveDataColumns() which only saves to storage without updating sync.Service.seenDataColumnCache. Subsequent equivocating data column with same (slot, proposer, index) bypasses anti-equivocation check since cache returns false.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Malicious validator proposes block with data column DC1, then broadcasts equivocating DC2 via P2P gossip. Cache was never marked for DC1, so DC2 passes hasSeenDataColumnIndex check and propagates, violating anti-equivocation.
